meta.tagline: Carmel NY inpatient · Liberation Programs Inc.
meta.author: Aleksandar Spasevski
meta.doc_subtitle: Carmel Map Pack dominated and improving · service-page form missing (24K sessions at 0 conversions) · insurance-article cluster 214K imp at <0.5% CTR · schema bare on Tier-1 pages.

tldr: Arms Acres' Carmel inpatient pin dominates Putnam County across its 169-cell grid and is still improving scan over scan: drug rehab top-3 +10 cells (101 to 111), alcohol rehab near me +8 (115 to 123), detox center near me +2 (128 to 130), with 100% top-20 coverage on the three high-intent queries. The lift now comes from four on-site moves on the pages this pin already feeds: deploy the missing service-page intake form (24,000 sessions a year convert at zero today because the pages carry a call button but no form, a 480 to 720 conversion opportunity at a 2 to 3% rate); lift the ten-article insurance cluster ranking 11 to 20 (214,000 impressions over 180 days at under 0.5% CTR, with title and FAQ-schema rewrites only); ship the broad-term /alcohol-rehab-new-york and /detox-new-york service pages; and deploy LocalBusiness, Service, and FAQPage schema across the Tier-1 pages (Organization on the homepage only today). The Carmel Google Business profile gets a full optimization pass in parallel.

kpis.detail: 169-cell grid, monthly cadence at 41.587, -73.908. drug rehab top-3 +10 cells Jan→Apr (101→111). alcohol rehab near me top-3 +8 (115→123). detox center near me top-3 +2 (128→130). Median rank 2-8. Dominating + improving on the revenue-engine pin.

kpis.label: Service-page conversion mechanism
kpis.detail: 24,000 sessions a year on /service/* and /inpatient/* produce 0 form-conversions because there is no form on the page, only a Call Now button. At 2 to 3% form-completion rates this is +480 to +720 annual conversions against the portfolio's current 531 a year baseline.

kpis.label: Insurance-article CTR-lift cluster
kpis.detail: 10 insurance / payor / cost articles ranking 11-20 with 214K combined impressions / 180d at <0.5% CTR. Top-3 average CTR ≈ 30%. Title + FAQ-schema rewrites on already-ranking pages = projected ~14× clicks at top-3 average CTR (~17K clicks vs ~1.2K today).

kpis.label: Schema coverage (Tier-1 pages)
kpis.detail: Organization schema on the homepage only. Zero JSON-LD on /inpatient/adult-rehabilitation, /inpatient/detox-program, and every /service/* page (12 URLs including 4 near-duplicates). Closes rich-result and AI-citation eligibility on the Tier-1 surfaces.

It holds 100% top-20 coverage across the high-intent searches and is still improving scan over scan (drug rehab +10 cells, alcohol rehab near me +8). The biggest gap is mechanical: roughly 24,000 service-page sessions a year convert at zero because those pages have a call button but no form. The plan fixes that service-page conversion path, lifts the insurance and payor content that already ranks just outside the top, and runs a full optimization pass on the managed Carmel Google Business profile.
